label: YOUR SIMPLE CHECKLIST
title:
Six months.
So much to explore.
note: Save this guide for your next shop.
voice: Baby six months or older? Here's a simple essentials checklist from Mama's Love.

label: 01 / MEALTIMES
title:
Ready for
little tastes.
note: Start solids around 6 months, when ready. Supervise every meal.
voice: For mealtimes: a secure high chair, soft spoons, a bowl, washable bibs, and an open cup. Start solids around six months when baby is ready.

label: 02 / MILK FEEDS
title:
Milk still
comes first.
note: Breast milk or infant formula is the main drink until 12 months.
voice: For milk feeds: breast feeding supplies, or bottles and sterilising equipment. Breast milk or infant formula remains baby's main drink until twelve months.

label: 03 / PLAY & DISCOVERY
title:
Little hands.
Big discoveries.
note: Choose age-appropriate toys with no small, loose parts.
voice: For play: a floor mat, soft blocks, sturdy books, and washable toys too large to swallow. Always supervise.

label: 04 / EVERYDAY CARE
title:
Fresh, comfy
and cared for.
note: First tooth? Brush with a smear of fluoride toothpaste.
voice: For everyday care: nappies, wipes, spare clothes, a soft towel, and a digital thermometer. Add a baby toothbrush when the first tooth appears.

label: 05 / SAFER SLEEP
title:
Keep sleep
simple.
items: A clear cot for every sleep
note: Put baby down on their back. No pillows, loose bedding or toys.
voice: For sleep: a firm, flat mattress, fitted sheets, and a suitable sleep sack. Put baby down on their back, with the cot clear.

label: 06 / OUT & ABOUT
title:
Ready for
your next outing.
note: Fasten stroller straps. Use the car seat for car journeys.
voice: For outings: a nappy bag, spare clothes, a sunhat, a stroller, and a suitable rear facing car seat for car journeys.

label: A LITTLE LOVE, EVERY DAY
title:
The basics.
And lots of love.
note: General guidance. Choose products suited to your baby's development.
voice: Start with the basics, mama. Save this checklist, and find more at mama's love dot N G.
